description: This file contains JUnit test cases for the PatientDataUnvoidHandler class in the OpenMRS project, specifically testing the unvoiding of patients, their encounters, orders, and associated cohort memberships.

classes.name: PatientDataUnvoidHandlerTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for testing the unvoiding functionality of PatientDataUnvoidHandler within the OpenMRS system.

methods.name: handle_shouldUnvoidTheOrdersAndEncountersAssociatedWithThePatient
methods.description: Tests that the handler correctly unvoids all encounters and orders associated with a specific patient.

methods.name: handle_shouldNotUnvoidTheOrdersAndEncountersThatNeverGotVoidedWithThePatient
methods.description: Ensures that encounters and orders not initially voided remain unaffected when the handler is invoked.

methods.name: handle_shouldUnvoidMembersAssociatedWithThePatient
methods.description: Verifies that the handler correctly unvoids cohort memberships associated with the patient.
